transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um... hi. I guess I'm here because... I've started doing things at work and school that don't really make sense. It's kind of hard to explain. 

Like... at my bookkeeping job, I'll catch myself lining up receipts all across the floor. Or I'll just sit there tapping the calculator... always in sets of nine. Sometimes I just... stand by the copier with my hands held up in the air. I don't really know why. I just stand there until someone comes by and asks if I'm okay. 

So... yeah. That's why I came in.
When you do these things, does it feel like you have to do them to stop a distressing thought or fear?
No, not really. I just... do them. I don't know.
Do you ever hear voices when no one else is there?

Um... yeah. Sometimes. 

I mean... mostly if I'm just alone at my desk, or... walking home from class. I'll hear... a man's voice. He just says things, like... "check line seven" or... "you missed the sign." It sounds really clear, so I usually look around, but... nobody's ever there. 

So... yeah.
When you stand with your hands up by the copier, do you feel unable to move even if you want to?
Um... no. I don't think so. I just... I don't really try to move. I just stand there.
When you line up the receipts or stand by the copier, is it because the voice tells you to do it?
Um... no. I don't think so. He doesn't really say anything about the receipts or the copier. It's just... separate, I guess. I just do it.
Do people tell you that your speech is hard to follow or that you jump from one idea to another?

Um... I guess so. Sometimes. 

Like... if I'm at work, trying to explain why a ledger is off... my thoughts just kind of jump around. I'll start thinking about... tuition deadlines, or tax rules. Or... studio lighting, and the patterns in the numbers. 

People tell me they can't follow how I got from one point to the next. So... yeah.
Has anyone told you that you stay in one position for a long time without moving or speaking?
Um... no. Not that I know of. Nobody's ever said that to me.
Do you have any strong beliefs that other people say aren’t true, like feeling watched, followed, or singled out in some special way?

Um... yeah, I guess. At work, mostly. 

I don't know... it's just... sometimes I look at the invoice totals, or account numbers... due dates... and I just know they mean something else. Like... they're messages. About me. 

My supervisor, he... he tries to show me they're just regular entries. But... I don't know. I still feel like... like they're tracking me. Seeing if I can figure out the pattern. 

People say it's not true, but... it feels true to me.
Has anyone ever moved your arms or body into a position and found that you stayed that way for a while?
Um... no. Nobody's ever done that. I don't really know why they would.
